topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture theme on cancer evolution and outlines the session's core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive somatic mutations and epigenetic chromatin alterations confer selective growth advantages during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate the role of cellular hierarchy, stem cell properties, and cell of origin in initiating and propagating malignancies across different tissues.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how extrinsic microenvironmental cues, chronic inflammation, and stromal interactions drive malignant progression and support established tumors.

topics.label: Experimental and computational technologies for studying tumor architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the single-cell and spatial profiling methods used to investigate cellular heterogeneity and microenvironmental interactions in tumors.

topics.label: Integrated evolutionary model of tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates genetic alterations, cell of origin, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental factors into a comprehensive model of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
